summary.headline: Middle and Minor Conjunctions
summary.text: Chapters XI and XII explain the middle conjunction of Mars and Saturn and the minor conjunction of Jupiter and Mars, relating them to war, discord, infirmity, weather, sterility, rain, frost, snow, and the effects of fortunate or evil aspects.
